question: Which state in India has the highest population density according to the 2011 Census?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Bihar.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bihar** **has the highest population density according to the** 2011 Census**.
 
• Bihar is the most thickly populated state with** 1106 **persons/square kilometer.
 
• Delhi is the most densely populated **Union Territory** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Some Important Facts of Census 2011.__**

 
 
• ​Highest Literacy Rate: **Kerala**
 
• Highest Populated State: **Uttar Pradesh**
 
• Highest Densely State: **Bihar**
 
• Highest Literacy Rate(U.T.): **Lakshadweep**
